newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Wednesday it reiterated a buy rating for Monsanto Co following strong third quarter results, released October 22, that beat expectations.
-- Monsanto earned $0.28 a share in the third quarter, up from last year's $0.23 a share or $0.20 from continuing operations. The consensus for the third quarter was $0.24.

-- Third quarter results benefited from timing of some bulk sales of aspartame and favorable effect of adjustment in full-year tax liability. As a result, Dain said it left unchanged its fiscal 1996 earnings estimate of $1.50 a share. The fourth quarter estimate was cut by $0.04 to $0.15.

-- "Monsanto's stock price has moved up fairly significantly in the last month or so as expectations for ag biotech earnings are increasing," Dain said. "Our original target price was $40 (a share)...."
-- Monsanto shares at mid-day Wednesday were up 1/8 at 42-5/8.
-- "We now believe (Monsanto) shares could approach $50 over the next six to 12 months as multiple expansion continues due to increasing investor interest," Dain said.
